messages:
maria (growth): quick sync: want a compact benchmark hero for the launch — focus on latency vs unit cost + one mobile-friendly chart. who owns what?
tejas (marketing): i'll run copy + experiment wiring. keep creative minimal so social cards are reusable.
olivia (design): suggest 3-panel hero: left = p50/p95 sparkline vs token length, center = stacked cost/1k tokens (hosted / dedicated / quantized), right = tiny heatmap for throughput (batch x seq). i'll do desktop + skinny mobile.
samir (pm): data source = last month v2-opt+quant runs. i'll drop a trimmed CSV into /bench/2026-q1/hero-ready.csv. include cold vs warm cache columns.
li (analytics): quick numbers check: hosted p50 ~80ms, p95 ~230ms for 512 tokens; hosted cost ~ $0.020/1k; dedicated quantized ~ $0.0055/1k. safe headline: "significantly lower unit cost on dedicated configs" + footnote.
nina (content): CTA variants to test: 1) "Start free" (trial) 2) "See cost savings" (book demo). short hero lines: a) "Predictable, production-grade LLM inference." b) "Fast p50s. Clear unit economics."
maria (growth): routing rules: trial signups >100k tokens/mo OR est spend >$2k/mo -> route to AE. we'll instrument lead form to capture estimated monthly tokens.
tejas (marketing): A/B plan: run 2-week test, track CTR, trial signups, demo requests, token usage. funnel metrics on dashboard.
olivia (design): placeholder heatmap for layout (seq_len rows, batch cols):
```
seq_len,batch,throughput
128,8,330
128,32,1100
1024,8,48
1024,32,160
```
use this to size cells.
samir (pm): also surface fallback behavior: if dedicated capacity unavailable route to compatible hosted variant; show that as a small note in the deck.
li (analytics): i'll create experiment tracking and segments: organic/social vs paid vs partners. also set goal for demo handoff rate for high-usage cohort.
maria (growth): timeline: design comps Thu, copy Fri, internal review Mon, launch experiment Wed. owners: olivia design, nina copy, tejas analytics, samir data, maria launch.
nina (content): i'll draft two hero lines + three social captions and drop in the doc by EOD. want technical but approachable tone.
tejas (marketing): avoid absolute multiplier claims in hero. we can include "up to 3x lower unit cost" in a secondary callout with qualifiers.
olivia (design): noted. i'll leave space for the qualifier footnote on desktop and shrink it on mobile.
maria (growth): one last ask: can we include a micro customer quote if legal clears? small 1-liner increases trust.
samir (pm): i'll ping solutions for a short blurb. thanks team
